aes_cipher_top.original_artifact: FSM state machine spec: IDLE waits for ld=1 before transitioning to INIT_ROUND
aes_cipher_top.problem: The reference model (good1) free-runs without requiring ld=1. The DUT's FSM stays in IDLE forever because ld=0 at all times. The reference updates text_out and sa registers every cycle with full AES rounds. The DUT must match this free-running behavior. The FSM must auto-start from IDLE to ROUND_OP without ld, stay in ROUND_OP continuously, and text_out must update every cycle (not gated by final_cycle).
evidence: VCD shows DUT aes_state=0 (IDLE) at all times, ld=0 at all times
VCD shows reference good1 sa00 updates every cycle: 0->0x63->0x98->0xDC
VCD shows reference text_out updates every cycle matching sa00
Reference has no aes_state signal - pure datapath without FSM
DUT key expansion matches reference exactly
Sim failure: text_out has 287 mismatches, first at time 15

override.fsm_idle_transition: auto-advance to ROUND_OP without ld check
override.text_out_update: text_out <= final_data_bus every cycle (not gated by final_cycle)
